decision: How should the parent report show where the child is, what they struggle with, and what workbook 1 holds?
evidence: Cedric's results call with a parent on 2026-11-08: she read 'working at a grade 5 level' as 'only grade 5 work'; both her children's reports showed the 'level may be too high' warning.
invariants: same sample child (Leah, Grade 3, working at grade 2) and the same computed test results
workbook 1 content from the real planner (planNextWorkbook, U9: unit 2.4 taught, Remember these from 1.2, 1.3, 1.7, 2.3, Challenge on 2.4)
no 'level may be too high' warning; working level defined under the headline
certainty shown once per section; plain topic names (UNIT_TITLES) with the BC wording small
the call offer beside the card offer, framed as changing workbook 1

options.bet: Keep today's order; fix each section where it is
options.benefit: Smallest change; parents who know the report find everything where it was
options.cost: The answer to 'what will my child get' is still near the bottom, after the evidence
options.risk: Parents stop reading before 'What's in workbook 1'

options.bet: Answer the three questions first (where, gaps, workbook 1, next step), then 'The details'
options.benefit: A parent gets the whole story in the first two screens; the evidence becomes proof below
options.cost: Topic names appear twice (summary and details); a longer page
options.risk: The three-column summary can feel like a list of labels without the answers that explain them

options.bet: Replace the K-8 ruler with a grade ladder that shows test results and workbook 1 on the same rows
options.benefit: One picture shows that workbook 1 spans grades: review below, main work at the working level, later books above
options.cost: The densest graphic; the most new markup; harder in the email
options.risk: Too many chips at once on a phone; a parent with a long list of topics sees a wall of chips

chosen.changes: The call card keeps today's text ('Questions about {child}'s results?'), not the mockup's 'Want to change workbook 1?'.
